denominator: public top-level Java source types; not methods or engineering operations
interpretation: Mentions and declared routes do not prove execution, full class exposure or engineering qualification. Explicit supported operations are bounded to their recorded signatures, units, applicability and examples.

capabilities.title: Mechanistic corrosion screening
capabilities.limitations: Screening does not establish plant integrity or inhibitor performance.

capabilities.title: Bounded dynamic process study
capabilities.limitations: Not all equipment provides a qualified transient model; preserve initial conditions and event assumptions.

capabilities.title: Electrolyte scale screening
capabilities.limitations: Parameter availability, minerals and validity ranges must be checked for each brine.

capabilities.title: Bounded engineering unit conversions
capabilities.limitations: Only the listed pure static conversions are supported. Rate conversions that depend on fluid state, composition, or standard conditions remain outside this contract.

operations.applicability: Absolute and gauge pressure conversions using the explicit source and target units; gauge conversions use NeqSim's fixed reference atmosphere.
Absolute temperature conversions. Use convertDifference for temperature intervals.
Temperature interval conversions without absolute-scale offsets.
Linear length conversions between the accepted unit symbols and aliases.
Linear elapsed-time conversions between the accepted unit symbols and aliases.
Linear power conversions between the accepted engineering units.
Linear energy conversions between the accepted engineering units.

capabilities.title: Separator and compressor sizing
capabilities.limitations: Sizing support does not expose every mechanical-design API or certify a design.

capabilities.title: Production profiles and cash flow
capabilities.limitations: Economic assumptions and fiscal-model applicability remain explicit caller inputs.

capabilities.title: Compose a multi-area process
capabilities.limitations: Only canonical process-JSON connections and preserved properties are supported.

capabilities.title: Steady and two-fluid pipeline calculations
capabilities.limitations: Select the applicable solver and closures; transient behavior needs case-specific validation.

capabilities.title: Compressor in a process model
capabilities.limitations: Vendor maps, operating envelope and driver limits need separate qualification.

capabilities.title: Build and solve a separation train
capabilities.limitations: Registration covers JSON builder support, not all equipment setters or every topology.

capabilities.title: CME and CVD experiments
capabilities.limitations: Experimental input and fluid characterization must be supplied; test presence is not a fluid-specific calibration.

capabilities.title: Static sulfur vapour pressure
capabilities.limitations: Search for calculateVapourPressureBar and invoke its exact double signature; this does not qualify other methods.

operations.applicability: Pure sulfur vapour pressure for 312.15 K through 1308.15 K; values outside the correlation range are rejected.

capabilities.title: TP flash of a defined fluid
capabilities.limitations: Only models and flash modes supported by run_flash schema; not every thermodynamic system or operation.
